integrity.scientific_scope: Proved exact recurrence for minimum isolating-set membership on every finite tree, and linear-time recognition using a known theorem. Finite brute-force experiments are checks, not general proof.
integrity.unresolved_risk: The source expressly predicts a rerooting solution; related unpublished routines may exist.

limitations: Tree inputs only. Single-subdivision criterion applies only to nonstar trees and invokes a published characterization. No classification of isolation subdivision numbers 2, 3, or 4. Historical priority and independent validation outstanding.
title: Linear-time minimum-isolation membership and one-subdivision recognition in trees
